items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like all the black folk who are sixty, they buying Jay-Z records.

What a jackass reason to be a musician. It’s just, you know…. I just, I be a jazz musician. I love doing it. I’m doing it. It’s something that…. I said I could see myself at the age of sixty doing this. I couldn’t see myself at the age of sixty wearing jump suits and singing pop tunes. I couldn’t see it. No, sequins…
